note: Hook archetypes for the first 0-3 s. Every example line is written fresh for the pack and is generic: no brand, no real product, no number. A line with a digit needs a sourced claim (lint.proof). The universal frame-0 rule is the pack's one hook rule (skills/motion-pack/references/virality.md section 1); `frame0` here adds what each archetype needs on top of it. Evidence and grades: docs/research/launch-video-patterns.md section 2 (hooks).

grades.platform: published by the platform (its help pages, ad guides or commissioned studies it publishes)
grades.study: a measured study (academic, or a named research firm with a stated method)
grades.practitioner: editors, creators, agencies, vendors: belief from practice, not measured
grades.inference: our synthesis of the sources; a tunable house default

universal.frame0: A strong image already in motion; first visible change by frame 6; never black, never a logo bumper, never a fade-in from nothing.
universal.first_sound: On frames 0-3, or 1-2 s later on the first meaningful visual event over a moving frame 0 (a planned quiet open in plan.audio.quiet).
universal.hook_text: On screen by 0.3 s when the hook uses text; at most 7 words; at most 4 on the poster frame.
universal.brand: A brand cue inside the action (the product in frame, the UI, the brand colour) within the first 2-5 s for ads; never a standalone logo card first.

hooks.label: Show the result first
hooks.use_when: The end state is visual and satisfying (a finished build, a clean desk, a solved problem). Tutorials, feature drops, output montages.
hooks.frame0: The finished result fills the frame and is already moving (a slow push or a reveal sweep). Rewind or cut to the start by about 1.2 s.
examples: This took four minutes. Here's how.
Same file. One click.
From a blank page to this.

hooks.label: Break the expected frame
hooks.use_when: A crowded feed where the category looks the same; comedy; a format the viewer recognises and you can subvert in under 3 s.
hooks.frame0: An odd or impossible image (wrong scale, wrong place, a familiar format interrupted). Three visual states in the first 3 s.
examples: Nobody asked the stapler.
This meeting could have been a sticker.
Wait. Wrong video.

hooks.label: Name the viewer's problem as a line
hooks.use_when: The problem is common and wordable; software with no hero object; explainers.
hooks.frame0: The line builds word by word on the beat from frame 0 (no blank frame before the first word); the picture behind it already moves.
examples: Why does every handoff break?
Your notes are lying to you.
Still copying this by hand?

hooks.label: Start in the middle of the moment
hooks.use_when: A story with a clear moment of failure or action; vlogs; short films; founder stories.
hooks.frame0: The moment of failure or action is already happening (the cup tipping, the deadline alarm). Whip or cut back to the setup after it lands.
examples: Ten seconds before it all went wrong.
The printer chose violence.
That's the third time today.

hooks.label: Show part of it and hold the rest
hooks.use_when: Teasers, hardware reveals, a design worth waiting for. The payoff must arrive in the same video or on a stated date.
hooks.frame0: A partial or blurred reveal already in motion (an edge lit from the dark, a silhouette, a mask opening). The full reveal lands later on a music hit.
examples: You've never seen one from this side.
Something is coming.
Look closer.

hooks.label: Lead with a real, sourced result
hooks.use_when: You have a measured number or a real quote with permission. Never with placeholder data.
hooks.frame0: The number counts up or the quote card lands from frame 0, with its source on screen. A digit without a source fails lint.proof.
hooks.needs: a claim with a real source in plan.claims
examples: Teams asked for this one first.
What changed after the first week.
Here's what the test showed.

hooks.label: Make the problem worse, fast
hooks.use_when: Ads with one clear pain; a 3-cut escalation into the product.
hooks.frame0: The pain is visible on frame 0; three cuts escalate it inside 3 s; the last cut smashes to the product.
examples: One tab. Two tabs. Nine tabs.
It was fine. Then it wasn't.
And then the client called.

hooks.label: Watch it do the thing
hooks.use_when: AI products and tools whose action is the proof: a prompt typed and answered, an agent working, a one-take demo.
hooks.frame0: The input is already being typed or the work is already running on frame 0 (a cursor moving, a prompt half-written). The real UI, never an image model's redraw.
examples: Ask it anything about this file.
Watch it plan the whole week.
One sentence in. A draft out.

hooks.label: An out-of-context moment
hooks.use_when: Trailers and teasers; a story told later in order. The moment must make sense by the end.
hooks.frame0: A striking moment from the middle of the story with its own sound (a line, a breath, an impact). A title or brand cue by 5 s on social cuts.
examples: Don't open that door.
We have one try.
Who left the lights on?

hooks.label: An edge lit out of darkness
hooks.use_when: Hardware and physical products; a hero object worth looking at.
hooks.frame0: A sliver of the object already lit and moving (a band of light sweeping an edge); the first sound is a swell or a tone, not silence. Not a black frame: some light is on screen at frame 0.
examples: (no words: light and sound only)
Made to be held.
Quiet, until it isn't.

hooks.label: The sharpest sentence first
hooks.use_when: Podcast clips, interviews, talking heads: open on the most quotable or contrarian line of the window.
hooks.frame0: The speaker is mid-sentence on frame 0 with the key phrase as large captions; the context comes after.
examples: Most meetings are a tax on focus.
I'd never hire for that skill again.
We were wrong about pricing.

hooks.label: Say what the viewer will get
hooks.use_when: Tutorials and explainers where the viewer came with a question; long-form intros.
hooks.frame0: The end result is visible (or the question on screen) while the line states the promise; the steps start inside 10 s.
examples: Three steps, no plugins.
By the end you'll build this.
The one setting that fixes it.

hooks.label: A person with a stake, talking straight to you
hooks.use_when: Founder launches and personal stories where the person is the credibility.
hooks.frame0: The founder already speaking on frame 0, mid-thought, beside the product or in the place the problem lives; a name super by about 5 s.
examples: I built this because I kept losing it.
This is the thing I wanted for years.
We spent a year on one button.
